data.content_ref: inline:Replace Boolean att with bounded integer weights and define the grounded labeling as a function of threshold τ; because the labeling map is monotone in τ, each τ yields the unique deterministic fixpoint and a single sweep over τ stays polynomial. Conjecture: committed-root validity is preserved iff τ strictly exceeds the weight of every attack edge incident to a committed root — turning the validity guarantee into a threshold-placement rule rather than a graph check.
